newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs sell $0.50 lower -dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs sell $0.50 lower -dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs early Friday sold $0.50 per cwt lower, but prices could weaken further amid continued light demand from packers fighting unprofitable operating margins, livestock dealers said.
Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hogs sold $0.50 lower at $55.00 to $56.50 in the country and $57.00 to $58.00 at plants in light activity, sources there said.
Illinois hogs sold $0.50 lower at $56.00 to $56.50 in the country and $57.00 to $57.50 at plants. Indiana hogs sold $0.50 lower at $54.00 to $54.50 in the country and $56.50 to $57.00 at plants.
